notes.title: New Game Reveal — Survival Sandbox ‘Nighthold’
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28269558/6ef668284e8b00b070a7a26a848bca76aa1d9395.gif

Greetings Hunters!

We’re thrilled to introduce a new game we've been working on — Nighthold.

Nighthold is a co-op sandbox RPG with survival elements, where you’ll need to build shelters, known as 'Nightholds,' interact with survivors, and fight off raiders and the Rot to survive another night.
It all starts with a corporate starship crash, leaving the crew stranded on a harsh alien planet. Each night, the Rot rises from the ground — a mysterious phenomenon that destroys everything it can reach. To survive, the locals build Nightholds, or elevated shelters.

Your ultimate goal is to find a functioning escape pod to send a distress signal, but that’s much easier said than done: in addition to the relentless Rot, you’ll face rival human camps and uncover ancient technologies left behind by a lost civilization. But first of all, you must survive.
Open World, Endless Possibilities
The open, fully destructible world of Nighthold reacts to your every action, ensuring that everything you do leaves an impact. The game features realistic weather and fire systems: you can set a building ablaze and watch it burn to the ground. Craft, cook, fish, and interact with NPCs who live their own lives, build their own camps, and respond to your decisions. Form alliances, complete quests, or annihilate anyone who stands in your way. The world is alive, and your fate depends on how you engage with it.


Build by Day, Survive by Night
The day is your time to prepare: gather resources, craft tools and weapons, and fortify your Nighthold. But when night falls, the Rot emerges, infecting enemies, buildings, and even people around you. Defend against rotten enemies and control this mighty infection to turn the tide in your favour — or succumb to it yourself.


Together or Alone
Survive solo or team up with friends in seamless cross-platform co-op play. Work together to build, explore, and conquer the night — or face the challenges of this unforgiving world on your terms.

Make sure to wishlist Nighthold and stay tuned — more updates are coming soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376960/Nighthold/

Cheers!

notes.title: Strangewood DLC available!
notes.content:
Epic news Hunters!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28269558/4bdf3a187bb19aa7b666781feccaafdb99867b4d.jpg
A first big content DLC for Quest Hunter is now live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851540/Quest_Hunter_Strangewood/
Explore new locations, fight with new enemies, solve puzzles with new mechanics. Level up new skills and get new weapons and equipment. Play alone or together with your old and new friends!

There's something strange going on in the western woods. An enormous cloud of blue mist sucks up everything around. What used to be a wonderful forest is drastically changing. Even bandits tend to avoid these places.

It's high time for the Hero to visit these lands and put things right!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28269558/cb145c031cc5fb4b02fca9522a0c77771adf604d.gif
Basic Features

     Continuation of the story with a new storyline.
     New addictive quests.
     New locations in incredible style.
     New memorable enemies.
     New charismatic characters.
     New epic (and not so epic) weapons and equipment.
     New necessary (and not so necessary) skills and advanced character leveling.
     New game mechanics and tricky puzzles.
     New deadly generated dungeons.


We've been working hard for about a year to release really great DLC for Quest Hunter with the best quality! We hope you enjoy it!

Cheers!

We have done great optimisation work because we had not the best performance on Switch. And now we have uploaded this new version to Steam. So, if you have not the best device to play, this update will give you better performance.

Also, we have added some not major features like Steam Rich Presence for a better experience with friends.
Had fixed many bugs. Tuned some quests logic.
Now you can change difficulty at any time from easy to hard and back.

Done Japanese localisation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28269558/d21f6e8dcb180e2dfa6429c750721952ac2341e5.png

And yes, we are working on the new content for the game. And with other localisations.

Cheers!

STORY
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28269558/355d98b55fa5274fe22e4a4ff24ddb2b04849897.jpg
The story tells us about the adventures of the pilot of the airship that crashed under mysterious circumstances. Player’s choices will influence the storyline. You will have to prevent evil plans of villains, find love and change the fate of the world of course.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28269558/050242f24e55a4f16a3797aaddde9ab99090e46f.jpg

GAMEPLAY
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28269558/19daae9a3d8b9bb814d35bff9b35b9d112a9b242.jpg
Dialogues and story development of the game are inseparably linked with the completion of various puzzles and quests. Completing them, the player will be able to take a number of paths with a variety of consequences. Combats with enemies of two types, monsters and men, are intermingled in the gameplay. Each enemy type requires special combat tactics. For instance, monsters prefer sticking to darkness and are afraid of the torchlight. The player will have to use it quite often!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28269558/413415518de7935c468f31343df8cc98350f98eb.jpg
Character upgrade and his skills development are also an integral part of the gameplay. Plus, searching for and management of equipment, weapons and armor.
